decisions.reason: A digital anamnesis and consent app fits Dampsoft's dental practice software core, and demand for paperless practice workflows grew after 2020, so it is likely an active product line.

A continuing education institute supports customer loyalty and software training, and such institutes in the dental market tend to persist, though the pandemic may have pushed it toward online formats.
A remote screen sharing support tool is essential support infrastructure for a practice software vendor and became even more important during the pandemic.
A practice performance analytics dashboard is a value-added module built on the existing practice data and is cheap to maintain alongside the core software.
The complete practice bundle is a sales package that may be repackaged or renamed, but it most likely stays on offer in some form.

The job and practice listing portal lies further from the core business and faces competition from established portals, so it carries more risk, but its low running cost and community value make keeping it more likely.
